source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
My rough calculation is that, on a 70×50 board (3500mm²), the components would occupy around 1300mm² (~37% coverage). That is comfortably within standard PCB density and should allow clean routing on 4 layers.

I would rather retain the separate JST connectors instead of combining them into a 2x15+10p. Modularity matters for the enclosure: every sensor has its own clean cable, and the boards slide into rails. Using one large connector with a fan-out ribbon cable would create very messy internal enclosure wiring and make servicing difficult.
Because all the components are already placed in KiCad, could you resize the board outline to 70×50 and make a rough rearrangement? I lack KiCad skills, so something that would take you minutes with the full project already open would take me hours. I would really appreciate it if you could attempt the resize on your end.

I have noted that the ESP32 needs to be on the edge, and that is fine.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
These are some constraints that come to mind:

Constraints that apply in either orientation:
\- Put J\_BAT on a short edge, since the battery sits alongside the PCB
\- Place USB-C on a short edge because it is user-facing
\- Keep the display connectors (J\_DISP\_SPI / J\_DISP\_I2C / J\_DISP\_LED) together on the edge nearest the route for the display flex
\- Point the ESP32-S3 antenna end away from the battery and maintain a ≥3mm keepout

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: J2, CN5, CN17, R14, R19–R21, R25, S1 are located within the WROOM-1 "recommended antenna clear area". The critical keep-out is acceptable—there is no copper directly beneath the antenna trace—because the antenna extends beyond the board. I only want to confirm whether you are OK with the slightly reduced WiFi range caused by placing those parts in the secondary keepout, or whether you would prefer to try clearing that area.

ambiguity.description: It remains unresolved whether components may remain in the secondary recommended antenna clear area with reduced WiFi range or whether that area must be cleared.
